Jujutsu sorcerers are trained to exorcise these curses using powerful techniques and tools passed down through generations. The Tokyo Metropolitan Curse Technical College is one such organization that trains and employs jujutsu sorcerers, who work tirelessly to protect the people from various cursed creatures terrorizing them. Sorcerers must face great danger in their constant battle against curses, but they do so for the sake of humanity's safety and peace.
